name: Garnet International Limited
about: Garnet International Limited operates as a non-banking finance company in India. The company engages in investing in listed and unlisted equity shares, debt instruments, and mutual funds. It also manufactures and sells garments, such as sportswear, lounge wear, inner wear, and compression wear, as well as knitted fabrics. Garnet International Limited was founded in 1981 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
